title: 第三章 村子外面来人了第四章 修一条路
content_zh:
受着身体之中的变化，这时候再按照自己脑海之中的已经发生改变的吐息之法不断推陈纳新，宋风只感觉全身都通透了一些。
“没成想这古老的筑基之法竟然是真的，在现实世界之中竟然也能炼出东西，这面板有些意思。”
看着面板上面的东西，感受着自己身体之中，随着每一次呼吸吞吐都涌动的气息，修行六十年，宋风第一次感觉原来这才是吐纳。
老爷子说修行之道在借假修真，坚定的认为便可改变某些东西，呼吸吐纳之法常修常静与身体大有好处，但终究也是个虚幻的玩意儿。
如今不一样了。
这气息竟然从虚假的转变为真实的气息，从看不见摸不着的呼吸变为了气贯全身一样的充盈感觉，这可就有点儿真正炼假成真，借假修真的意味了。
“精满气足，若是如此说的话，那贫道也只不过是气息小成，充盈全身，还到不了气足之境？”
摇了摇头走出门外，带着两个徒弟在院落之中继续打着八段锦，五禽戏，不断的调养身子，养育气血。
每日师徒三人都如此练习。
太阳出来，带着一丝丝的红光照在三人身上，拉出一道道残影，朝阳之下，露珠更加璀璨，草木也更加清脆。
鸟儿站在树上叽叽喳喳叫着，抖一抖身上的羽毛，转着脑袋奇奇怪怪的看着道观中的三人。
热腾腾的早饭出来。
还是每人两个馒头，一块肉块，连带着半碗的米汤，师徒三个人细嚼慢咽，轻轻将口中粮食磨碎，完成每日一餐。
阳光照下来，种在地里的小麦豆子也开始有了几分的色彩，宋风拿着锄头在地底下轻轻杵两下，叮当作响，让种着的两亩大豆土地更松软。
一个恍惚，中午便到。
呼吸吐纳自然的宋风只感觉每一次将锄头刨下去，身体之中就有一股带动全身的气力，以至于一早上整了好几亩地，都没感觉疲惫似的。
呼吸更加悠长，山中的风也愈加的凉爽，深吸一口就感觉整个人从头凉到脚，哪怕中午也没那么燥热了。
这吐纳之术果真有点东西。
看着长出来带着些绒毛的豆苗，再看看那早就种上的小麦，还有被他种在山间并不犄角处的那些红薯，这十几亩地连带着几方偏僻的地方，就是道观师徒三人一年的口粮。
“多去山中转一转摘些果子，弄些野菜，再打猎补贴些粮食，这一年总归还是能过下去的。”放下锄头，在老二宋志的手中拿过毛巾，和着清凉的水汽在身上擦一擦，也算是沐浴更衣了。

师徒三人都是男人，三个人一顿饭能把普通人家一天的饭食吃光，基本上年年都留不下什么存粮。
日子这么过下去，倒也逍遥自在。
没人压迫，没人催粮，也没什么税收，村子里更没有什么所谓的村长之类的人物，这般日子过的倒也算得上是世外桃源。
“师父，山下刘二婶家的老母鸡好像是下了几个蛋，要不我拿过来孵一下看看能不能行？”
“要是能多养上几只老母鸡的话，倒也不用夏日里花这么长时间入山去打些猎物，总归也能更有营养一些。”
老二没事就喜欢上山掏些鸟窝，对于吃食最是喜欢研究，先吃饱再吃好，如今他们距离吃的好的境地还远着呢。
山下刘二婶家确实有母鸡。
但这山村里母鸡也是分外珍贵，根本没什么人去养公鸡，养母鸡还一天一个蛋，两天一个蛋，只需要付出些草籽打些菜叶，多划算啊。
而听到了老二如此说，宋风却则是摇了摇头。
content_en:
Affected by the changes in his body, Song Feng felt that his whole body was a little more transparent as he continued to introduce new ones according to the breathing method that had changed in his mind.
"I didn't expect that this ancient foundation-building method is actually real, and that things can be made in the real world. This panel is interesting."
Looking at the things on the panel and feeling the breath surging in his body with every breath, Song Feng felt for the first time in sixty years of practice that this was breathing in and out.
The old man said that the way to practice is to use falsehood to cultivate the true. If you firmly believe that you can change something, regular practice of breathing and exhalation is very beneficial to the body, but it is still an illusion after all.
It's different now.
This breath actually changed from false to real breath, from invisible and intangible breath to a full feeling like Qi penetrating the whole body. This is a bit like truly refining the fake to become the real, using the fake to cultivate the real.
"If energy is sufficient and Qi is sufficient, if that is the case, then the poor Taoist is just a small perfection of Qi, which fills the whole body, but cannot reach the state of Qi sufficient?"
He shook his head and walked out, leading his two apprentices to continue playing Ba Duan Jin and Wu Qin Xi in the courtyard, constantly recuperating his body and nourishing his energy and blood.
The three masters and disciples practice this every day.
The sun came out, shining a ray of red light on the three of them, leaving behind shadows. Under the rising sun, the dewdrops were even brighter and the vegetation was crisper.
The bird stood on the tree and chirped, fluttering its feathers and turning its head to look at the three people in the Taoist temple strangely.
Hot breakfast comes out.
Each person still had two steamed buns, a piece of meat, and half a bowl of rice soup. The three masters and apprentices chewed slowly and gently ground the grain in their mouths to complete their daily meal.
As the sun shone down, the wheat beans planted in the ground began to take on a bit of color. Song Feng took a hoe and gently hammered it twice under the ground, making a clanging sound, making the two acres of soybean land softer.
In a daze, noon arrived.
Song Feng, who was breathing naturally, felt that every time he dug the hoe down, there was a force in his body that drove the whole body, so much so that he didn't feel tired after plowing several acres of land all morning.
The breath is longer, and the wind in the mountain is cooler. Taking a deep breath makes you feel that your whole body is cold from head to toe. Even at noon, it is not so hot anymore.
There really is something to this breathing technique.
Looking at the bean sprouts that have grown with some fluff, and then looking at the wheat that he planted earlier, and the sweet potatoes that he planted in remote corners of the mountains, these dozen acres of land with several remote places are the three Taoist masters and apprentices' annual rations.
"Go to the mountains more often to pick some fruits, get some wild vegetables, and hunt to subsidize some food. You can survive this year after all." Put down the hoe, took the towel from the hands of the second son Song Zhi, and wiped it with the cool water vapor on his body, which was regarded as a bath and change of clothes.
The three masters and apprentices are all men. The three of them can eat up the food of an ordinary family for a day in one meal. Basically, there is no food left over every year.
Life goes on like this, but it feels carefree.
No one oppresses, no one urges for food, and there are no taxes. There is no so-called village chief or the like in the village. Living like this can be considered a paradise.
"Master, the old hen at Aunt Liu's house down the mountain seems to have laid a few eggs. How about I take them over and hatch them to see if they work?"
"If we could raise a few more old hens, we wouldn't have to spend so much time in the mountains hunting prey in the summer, and it would be more nutritious."
The second child likes to go to the mountains to dig out some bird's nests when he has nothing to do. He likes to study food the most. He eats full first and then eats well. Now they are still far from being able to eat well.
Aunt Liu's house at the foot of the mountain does have hens.
But hens are also extremely precious in mountain villages. No one raises roosters at all. Hens only produce one egg a day.For one egg every two days, you only need to pay for some grass seeds and some vegetable leaves. What a deal.
But after hearing what Lao Er said, Song Feng shook his head.
